items.title: Public companies double share of blockchain revenue since 2022: Report
items.summary: A new 1kx report finds that public companies are capturing a larger share of blockchain revenue, driven by institutional adoption and real-world applications.

items.title: Polymarket suspended trading amid reports of user funds being drained
items.summary: The prediction markets platform halted trading on Thursday after it reported one of its third party providers had been compromised.

items.title: HYPE teases all-time high as NYSE owner ICE eyes US Hyperliquid perps
items.summary: Hyperliquid's token pumped following news of ICE and Trade[XYZ] unveiling plans for US perpetual futures.

items.title: KuCoin suspends services in Russia and Belarus
items.summary: The exchange cited legal and regulatory compliance in its reason for cutting off services to users based in the two countries, currently the targets of international sanctions.

items.title: Nasdaq-listed Canton Strategic Holdings plans tokenized stock trading from Nov. 2
items.summary: The tokenized shares would carry the same shareholder rights as traditional stock, with round-the-clock trading and immediate settlement under the SEC's innovation exemption.

items.title: Kalshi raises $1B at $40B valuation as non-sports revenue run rate tops $1B
items.summary: The funding round comes as Kalshi expands its partnerships with the NBA and S&P Dow Jones Indices while facing legal challenges over its sports contracts.

items.title: Chrome Can Now Pull Details From Your Gmail to Fill Out Web Forms
items.summary: Chrome's new autofill uses Google's Gemini AI to search your Gmail for order numbers, tracking details, and flight bookings and fill them into web forms. It is rolling out in the U.S.

items.title: Polymarket Pauses Trading as Prediction Market Investigates Security Incident
items.summary: Polymarket restricted trading and paused relayer actions as users report funds leaving their accounts. A suspected attacker wallet holds about $2.65 million in POL, per Arkham data.

items.title: Hackers Publish Work Details of 41,000 Homeland Security Employees
items.summary: A hacktivist group says it took names, titles, and phone numbers of 41,000-plus DHS staff from a login system.

items.title: Crypto Spends $176 Million on Midterms, But Only 13% of Voters See It as a Priority
items.summary: Industry PACs have poured $176 million into the 2026 midterms, yet a new poll finds only 13% of voters rank crypto among their top issues.

items.title: Hyperliquid's HYPE Jumps 13% as NYSE Owner ICE Moves to Bring Its Perpetual Futures to the US
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange signed a deal with Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated perpetual futures built on Hyperliquid in the United States, sending HYPE soaring.

items.title: Walmart Blocks Its Stock From OKX-ICE Tokenized Trading Venue
items.summary: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Cigna, Carnival and Arcos Dorados objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue.

items.title: Polymarket pauses trading after $2.65 million exploit, says third-party provider was compromised
items.summary: After over $2.5 million was lost within minutes on Polymarket, the platform said it has since placed its exchange in cancel-only mode.

items.title: HYPE surges 15% as NYSE parent ICE moves to bring Hyperliquid perps to US
items.summary: NYSE parent ICE will partner with and invest in Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated, Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures in the U.S.

items.title: Uniswap Labs opens fee conversion tool TJAR to apps, starting with Robinhood
items.summary: Uniswap Labs has opened up its Token Jar fee conversion system to other apps through a new tool called TJAR.

items.title: Polygon adds Solana to payment stack linking bank accounts, crypto and payouts
items.summary: Polygon added Solana to its payments platform, connecting businesses to bank funding, cross-chain transfers, stablecoins and global payouts.

items.title: Curve Finance launches on Stellar in first native deployment outside EVM ecosystem
items.summary: Curve Finance has launched on Stellar mainnet, its first native deployment outside the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) ecosystem.

items.title: Utah files criminal charges against Kalshi, executives over alleged illegal gambling
items.summary: Utah AG Derek Brown filed criminal charges against Kalshi, Tarek Mansour and Luana Lopes Lara for allegedly promoting online gambling.

items.title: FutureBit Apollo Solo Miner Finds Bitcoin Block 973262, Earning 3.154 BTC
items.summary: A miner running FutureBit's Apollo Solo setup found Bitcoin block 973,262 on Oct. 26, collecting the full 3.154 BTC subsidy-plus-fees reward from 2,477 transactions.

items.title: Bitcoin Magazine: Strategy Announces Daily Dividends for STRC Starting November
items.summary: The largest Bitcoin treasury company will begin daily dividend payments on STRC in November, with three other preferred securities following in January 2027.

items.title: Centralized Exchange and DeFi Losses Dominate 2026 Crypto Hacks Despite Hardware Wallet Failures
items.summary: CEX hot-wallet and DeFi incidents accounted for the bulk of 2026 losses; hardware-wallet events remained smaller in aggregate.

items.title: Metaplanet Buys Another 1,000 Bitcoin, Total Holdings Near 36,100 BTC
items.summary: Japanese public company Metaplanet continues its Bitcoin accumulation strategy with a fresh purchase.

items.title: Crypto Exchange HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With FCA
items.summary: HTX is leaving the UK under a confidential FCA settlement that ends its first crypto marketing case.

items.title: Understanding the Various Bitcoin Per Share Metrics
items.summary: Bitcoin per share, Bitcoin per assumed diluted shares, Net Bitcoin per share, and what to make of the metrics.

items.title: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses
items.summary: Polymarket said one of its third-party providers was breached after users reported seeing their accounts drained.

items.title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
items.summary: Druckenmiller's first post on X supports the Hyperliquid-linked Trade[XYZ] initiative.

items.title: KuCoin exits Russia and Belarus as crypto exchanges withdraw from Western-sanctioned markets
items.summary: The exchange is closing accounts in both countries after MEXC and Bitget announced similar moves earlier this month.

items.title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
items.summary: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.

items.title: Crypto exchange HTX exits the UK after settling with the FCA
items.summary: The former Huobi exchange has stopped accepting deposits from British customers and agreed not to target them with crypto promotions.

items.title: Polymarket brings ultra-short crypto prediction markets to U.S. platform
items.summary: Polymarket's new Up/Down crypto contracts come as the CFTC renews scrutiny of the prediction markets compliance with its 2022 U.S. onboarding terms.
